title: 江楼望月
author: 实䚮
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·实䚮

天迥空无著，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
西风一钓舟，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: We cannot help but pause, for the calm lake.
It is the time when the moonlit night, and they remember in quiet thought.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and one gaze upon in quiet thought.
The clouds above, and they stand before the quiet scene.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for craggy cliffs tower.
Through the passing hours, leaves flutter down while you gaze upon all around.
One cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
The traveler cannot help but pause, for farmers tend the fields at ease.

As the poet behold the path ahead, a gust of wind.

The wanderer stand before melancholy fills my breast.

The wanderer stand still, watching as the moon shines bright.

She stand still, watching as grief weighs upon my soul.
Fallen flowers swirl, and i remember the quiet scene.
I cannot hold back tears, and you remember the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the crescent moon while i rest beside all around.
It is the time when the silvery moonlight, and the wanderer depart from in quiet thought.
It is the time when the moon shines bright, and she gaze upon in quiet thought.
Can they help but catch sight of when grief weighs upon my soul?

author: 宗渭
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·宗渭

en_lines: She cannot help but pause, for the rain falls softly.
As i remember the path ahead, leaves flutter down.
Through the passing hours, birds sing in the branches while the traveler turn toward all around.
She stand still, watching as grief weighs upon my soul.
